installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Vaultwarden install script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
# Vaultwarden only ships container images. Their Alpine variant contains a static binary,
# so the image layers are fetched from Docker Hub and unpacked without Docker.
set -eo pipefail
trap 'echo "Install failed at line ${LINENO}: ${BASH_COMMAND}"' ERR

apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl ca-certificates jq tar gzip

case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) ARCH=amd64 ;;
    aarch64) ARCH=arm64 ;;
    *) echo "Unsupported architecture $(uname -m)"; exit 1 ;;
esac

REPO=vaultwarden/server
if [ -z "${VW_VERSION}" ] || [ "${VW_VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
    TAG=latest-alpine
else
    TAG=${VW_VERSION#v}-alpine
fi
REGISTRY=https://registry-1.docker.io/v2/${REPO}
ACCEPT="application/vnd.oci.image.index.v1+json,application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.list.v2+json,application/vnd.oci.image.manifest.v1+json,application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.v2+json"

TOKEN=$(curl -fsSL "https://auth.docker.io/token?service=registry.docker.io&scope=repository:${REPO}:pull" | jq -r .token)

registry_get() {
    curl -fsSL -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" -H "Accept: ${ACCEPT}" "$@"
}

echo "Resolving ${REPO}:${TAG} for linux/${ARCH}"
DIGEST=$(registry_get "${REGISTRY}/manifests/${TAG}" \
    | jq -r --arg arch "${ARCH}" '.manifests[] | select(.platform.os == "linux" and .platform.architecture == $arch) | .digest' | head -n1)
if [ -z "${DIGEST}" ]; then
    echo "No linux/${ARCH} image found for tag ${TAG}"
    exit 1
fi

MANIFEST=$(registry_get "${REGISTRY}/manifests/${DIGEST}")
VERSION=$(registry_get "${REGISTRY}/blobs/$(echo "${MANIFEST}" | jq -r .config.digest)" | jq -r '.config.Labels["org.opencontainers.image.version"] // "unknown"')
echo "Vaultwarden ${VERSION}"

ROOTFS=$(mktemp -d)
for layer in $(echo "${MANIFEST}" | jq -r '.layers[].digest'); do
    echo "Fetching layer ${layer}"
    registry_get "${REGISTRY}/blobs/${layer}" | tar -xz -C "${ROOTFS}" --no-same-owner --exclude='dev/*'
done

if [ ! -x "${ROOTFS}/vaultwarden" ] || [ ! -d "${ROOTFS}/web-vault" ]; then
    echo "The image layout changed, /vaultwarden or /web-vault is missing"
    exit 1
fi

cd /mnt/server
install -m 755 "${ROOTFS}/vaultwarden" vaultwarden
rm -rf web-vault
cp -a "${ROOTFS}/web-vault" web-vault
rm -rf "${ROOTFS}"
mkdir -p data
echo "${VERSION}" > .vaultwarden-version

echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Vaultwarden ${VERSION} installed"
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Domain
variables.description: Public HTTPS URL, e.g. https://vault.example.com. The web vault only works over HTTPS.

variables.name: Allow Signups
variables.description: Let anyone create an account. Turn off after creating your own accounts and use invitations.

variables.name: Allow Invitations
variables.description: Let organisation admins invite new users even when signups are off.

variables.name: Admin Token
variables.description: Enables /admin. Use an Argon2 PHC hash from "./vaultwarden hash" (starts with $argon2id$). Empty disables the admin page.

variables.name: Show Password Hints
variables.description: Show password hints on the login page instead of sending them by e-mail.

variables.name: Version
variables.description: latest or a release such as 1.37.5. Reinstall to update; data/ is kept.
